notes.title: MONSTROUS LOVE IS NOW AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
Thank you very much to everyone who's been waiting for this day!
You can now get all the monster boyfriends you've ever wanted!

We hope all of you have a great time experiencing our stories, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts!

We hope everyone has a monstrous time this Friday!

And remember, if you happen to come across any issues, please let us know in the game's discussion page, and we'll do our very best to fix them as quickly as possible <3
